{{Quote|My mother worked at things she should not have, harder than she should have, longer than she should have&mdash;just for me. [...] My mother worked herself to death for me.|Granta Omega tells the tale of his mother to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise">''[[Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise]]''</ref>}}
'''Tura Omega''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the wife of [[Xanatos]] and the mother of [[Granta Omega]]. When her son was three years old, she flew with him to [[Nierport VII]], where she worked at the gas station for years on the moon.

Because of Granta's brilliance, Tura eventually found a sponsor for him: [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sano Sauro]] of [[Eeropha]].
